query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `email_ab_tests` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `testName` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `variantASubject` text NOT NULL,
  `variantACtaText` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Rezervovat',
  `variantBSubject` text NOT NULL,
  `variantBCtaText` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Zobrazit nabídku',
  `variantASent` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `variantBSent` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `variantAOpened` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `variantBOpened` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `variantAClicked` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `variantBClicked` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `winner` varchar(10),
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `email_ab_tests_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
